name: Bulking cycle

lead: A bulking cycle is a mass-building period, normally in the off-season, where a lifter eats above maintenance to gain muscle. In bodybuilding and some looksmaxxing communities the term also refers to a course of anabolic steroids scheduled to coincide with that surplus.

The appeal is a bigger frame: more muscle on the shoulders, chest, arms and neck, which many people see as improving overall physique and presence. A calorie surplus is the part of the practice that is standard in bodybuilding; the drug component is controlled in many countries.

paras: People plan a bulk phase of several months with a calorie surplus, heavy training and high protein, then follow it with a cutting phase to lower body fat. Those who add drugs discuss stacks and timing on forums such as T Nation.

Anabolic steroids are controlled substances in many countries and are associated with cardiovascular, liver, kidney, hormonal and psychiatric effects. A large surplus also adds body fat that must later be dieted off.

chain: Drugs, where used, raise muscle-building capacity
angle.text: A bulk phase supplies the extra energy for building muscle, giving a larger physique in the shoulders, chest, arms and back. People who add drugs do so to increase how much size they gain in that window.

lead: A bulking cycle is a planned mass phase in which a lifter aims to add muscle size, usually in the off-season. The calorie surplus that defines bulking is standard in bodybuilding: competitors build in the off-season and diet down about 12 to 14 weeks before a show [1].

In forum usage, 'cycle' often implies a course of anabolic steroids run alongside the surplus, and T Nation members discuss such off-season courses with experienced users answering questions about them. Anabolic steroids are used non-medically mainly for appearance, are controlled in many jurisdictions, and carry documented adverse effects [2]. This article describes the practice; it gives no dosing or sourcing.
infobox: Anabolic steroids in some uses; controlled in many countries [2]

paras: Most competitive bodybuilders build muscle in the off-season by eating in a calorie surplus; a larger surplus or longer bulk adds more body fat, so surpluses are often kept modest [1]. Approaches range from 'clean' bulking, with tracked macronutrients, to 'dirty' bulking with a large untracked surplus, which can add size and strength quickly along with substantial fat [1].

sections.h: Use in looksmaxxing and bodybuilding communities
paras: On T Nation, lifters describe planning off-season bulking cycles around their competition schedule and ask experienced members for feedback on their plans. The wiki does not reproduce such protocols.

Reported effects of anabolic steroids include raised blood pressure and cholesterol changes, left ventricular thickening, liver injury with some oral compounds, suppressed natural testosterone, reduced fertility, gynecomastia, and mood and aggression changes [2]. Steroids are controlled in many countries, including Schedule III in the US [2].
No studies found on bulking cycles as a combined practice.
